description:
[Windows] Local Git repository operations — log, diff, status, blame, show. Read-only by default.

Prereq: install uv on Windows.
  winget install --id=astral-sh.uv -e
  # or: powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  uvx mcp-server-git --repository .

Note: change '.' to the absolute path (e.g. C:\\repos\\my-project).

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/git

[Windows] Persistent knowledge graph for cross-session memory — entities, relations, and observations in a local JSON file.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows (winget, nvm-windows, or installer). Java's ProcessBuilder needs npx.cmd on PATH.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory

Optional: set MEMORY_FILE_PATH in the env section to override the default storage path (e.g. C:\\Users\\<you>\\memory.json).

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory

[Windows] Structured step-by-step reasoning helper — logs intermediate thoughts to the server for review, revision, or branching.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows. Java's ProcessBuilder needs npx.cmd on PATH.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/sequentialthinking

[Windows] Headless Chrome automation — navigate, click, fill forms, screenshot, evaluate JavaScript in-page.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows. First run downloads ~170 MB Chromium under %USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\Local\\puppeteer.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer

Optional — set in the env section:
  PUPPETEER_LAUNCH_OPTIONS — JSON launch options, e.g. {"executablePath":"C:\\\\Program Files\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome.exe"}
  ALLOW_DANGEROUS — set to true to enable --no-sandbox

Security: visits arbitrary URLs as instructed by the agent — review prompts before granting net access.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/puppeteer

[Windows] Official MCP reference test server exercising every protocol feature — tools, resources, prompts, sampling, completion, logging, progress, root listing.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows. Java's ProcessBuilder needs npx.cmd on PATH.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything

Docker alternative:
  docker run -i --rm tzolov/mcp-everything-server:v2

Note: the hosted `example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io` endpoint requires OAuth and is not auto-activated.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/everything

[Windows] Microsoft's accessibility-snapshot browser automation — successor to the Puppeteer reference. Drives Chromium/Firefox/WebKit without screenshot vision models.

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows (winget, nvm-windows, or installer). First run downloads ~300 MB browser binaries under %USERPROFILE%\\AppData\\Local\\ms-playwright. Java's ProcessBuilder needs npx.cmd on PATH.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @playwright/mcp@latest

Optional flags:
  --browser firefox|webkit          # default chromium
  --port 8931                       # serve over HTTP instead of stdio

Security: visits arbitrary URLs as instructed by the agent — review prompts before granting net access.

Docs: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp

[Windows] Query a local SQLite database — SELECT, schema introspection, plus INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE when permitted.

Prereq: install uv on Windows.
  winget install --id=astral-sh.uv -e
  # or: powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  uvx mcp-server-sqlite --db-path C:\\path\\to\\your.db

Required arg:
  --db-path <path>                  # absolute path to the .db file (e.g. C:\\data\\sample.db)

Security: writes are allowed by default — point at a copy of the DB or a read-only mount if you don't want the agent modifying production data. Reference server is archived; community forks active.

Docs: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived/tree/main/src/sqlite

[Windows] Brave Search API — web, local, news, image, and video search. Outbound calls only to api.search.brave.com (no SSRF surface).

Prereq: Node.js 18+ on Windows (winget, nvm-windows, or installer). Java's ProcessBuilder needs npx.cmd on PATH. Free API key (2k req/month) at https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys.

The activated form is pre-filled to run:
  npx.cmd -y @brave/brave-search-mcp-server

Required — set BRAVE_API_KEY in the env section below (treat as a secret).

Docs: https://github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server
